_comment: Nanobot configuration template. Copy this file to nanobot.config.json and fill in the placeholders. See https://github.com/HKUDS/nanobot for full reference.

bot_pool._comment: Optional multi-bot pool: one always-on dispatcher bot plus T1/T2 'pool' bots that sub-agents can temporarily borrow to post into a project's group. See windows/src/project_registry.py and shared/config/projects.template.json. Tokens are read from environment variables, never stored here.
bot_pool._comment_assigned_project: assigned_project is the project_id (key in projects.json) currently borrowing this pool bot, or null if unassigned. Updated at runtime, not by hand.

session._comment_chat_history: chat_history.jsonl is rotated into chat_history_archive/ once its oldest entry exceeds idle_timeout_seconds * chat_history_rotate_multiplier. The archive is then pruned (oldest files first) to stay under chat_history_max_size_mb total.

quota._comment: Token-window quota for unattended research sweeps. Adjust to your usage patterns.

github._comment: Optional. Read-only GitHub PAT for repo lookups. Set env var GITHUB_TOKEN instead of hardcoding here.

_comment_allowed: Only these Telegram chat IDs can interact with the bot. Leave empty [] to allow any chat (not recommended). Get your chat ID by messaging @userinfobot on Telegram.
_comment_project_dir: Path (WSL) to the project-specific overlay directory. Contains state/, shared/prompts/dispatcher_system.md, etc.

auth._comment: OAuth token refresh for the WSL claude CLI. Adjust oauth_refresh_url if the default doesn't work (check wsl_auth.py logs).

_comment_wsl_project_root: WSL absolute path passed to the Claude Code subprocess as its working directory.
